note: The globe is sampled, not drawn. core/globe-dots.js is 2438 real coordinates baked from Natural Earth by `make globe-dots`, so every dot on the land is a place. The route is a true great circle (a slerp between JFK and CDG lifted off the surface), never the flat map's quadratic, because on a sphere the shortest path between two points IS that curve. Nothing in the scene accumulates: the spin, the route's draw-on and the aircraft's position are all f(t), which is what lets frame 900 render on a different worker to frame 899. Verified by make check GATE=canvas-purity.
